title: PhD Candidate — Optimal Planning for Space Surveillance Sensor Networks
description: Doctoral diploma in industrial collaboration. Research on optimal scheduling of heterogeneous space surveillance sensors (mechanical radars, phased array surveillance and tracking radars, telescopes, lasers, and RF sensors) under multi-domain operational constraints and environmental uncertainty.

title: Space Surveillance Research Engineer
description: Developing orbtial mechanics algorithms for the SYNAPSE space surveillance platform.

title: Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Orbital Mechanics Expert
description: Consulting mission to develop and improve orbital mechanics algorithms for collision-risk assessment, sensor visibility prediction, and ground-based measurement simulation.

title: M.Sc.A. in Artificial Intelligence
description: Masters diploma specialized in aerospace and AI, with research in the LARCASE laboratory on deep learning for orbital maneuver detection and satellite behavior modeling. Coursework in deep learning, machine learning, probabilistic learning (Bayesian networks, Gaussian methods, Markov models), and representation learning (GNN). Published two conference papers and one scientific poster.

title: Machine Learning Researcher
description: Researched data-driven orbital maneuver detection. Developed time-series deep forecasting models integrating exogeneous data (solar activity, ballistic coefficients) for orbital state prediction, and correction of traditional numerical propagators. Proposed conditionned Gaussian Mixture Models (CGMMs) for unsupervised anomaly detection based on external data, and a framework for maneuver characterization based on deep clustering and computer vision on Discret Wavelet Transform (DWT).

title: Engineering Degree in Aerospace Mechanics
description: Engineering school diploma (masters equivqlent) specialized in orbital mechanics, applied mathematics, optimization, data science, and satellite mission analysis.

title: Data Science & Orbital Mechanics Intern
description: Developed an analysis framework for the Special Perturbation (SP) numerical propagation model. Created ML-based methods for satellite maneuverability characterization using Isolation Forest, XGBoost. Designed maneuver detection methods by covariance error analysis using clustering (k-NN).
